# promo-svc

Human-authored documentation for the sample promo service.

This tree exists so the dashboard's **Docs** view has something real to list. The view used to be
the Wiki view, whose pages were generated by `kb/wiki.py`; that generator left with tier 3, and the
surviving half reads the repository's own `docs/` directory over `/api/docs`. Without a page here
the browser tests could only assert that the pane is attached — which passes just as well when the
fetch fails — so the fixture carries a page instead.

## Rules

`promo/rules.go` holds the discount rules; `promo/rules_engine.go` evaluates them against a cart.

## Fulfillment

`promo/fulfillment.go` applies an evaluated promotion to an order.
